extDescription.message: Blocks porn sites and filters adult content from social networks and search engines. Free, open source, no data collected.

copyTextDefault.message: I am trying to force open a door that I closed myself, with a clear head, because I knew this moment would come. This urge is a wave: it rises, it peaks, and then it always goes back down. I do not have to obey it. What I am really looking for right now is calm, rest or company, and there are other ways to get it.

wantAccess.message: I still want to access it

startExplain.message: This takes at least $1. If you go all the way, your streak ($2) resets to zero and the next wait will be doubled.

previewStep2.message: Type out a text by hand, no copy-paste.

previewStep3.message: Wait for the timer to finish.

previewStep4.message: Pass 5 captchas in a row. One mistake and they start over.

keepTabOpen.message: If you close or reload this tab, everything starts over.

step1Help.message: Answer honestly. Nobody else will read this: it stays on this device.

q1.message: What am I feeling right now? (bored, stressed, lonely, tired…)

q2.message: What happened just before the urge showed up?

q3.message: What do I actually need right now?

q4.message: What could I do instead for the next 15 minutes?

q5.message: Who could I talk to or text right now?

q6.message: Why did I install Rempart in the first place?

q7.message: What do I lose if I go through with this?

q8.message: How will I feel an hour from now if I go through with this?

step2Help.message: By hand, letter by letter. Copy-paste is disabled.

step3Locked.message: Available once the timer is done and steps 1 and 2 are complete.

step3Ready.message: Type the $1 codes in a row. A single mistake and it all starts over.

captchaWrong.message: Wrong. The captchas start over from the first one.

finalExplain.message: You held on for $1. If you continue, your streak resets and you get access to the site for $2 minutes. You can still stop here.

finalFailed.message: Could not validate ($1). Please start over.

proudText.message: You let the wave pass. Your streak keeps going. Stand up, drink a glass of water, go to another room for a few minutes.

filteredText.message: This page contains adult content. The rest of the platform remains available as usual.

filteredHome.message: Back to the site's home page

fpText.message: Rempart only blocks pornography. If this site is blocked by mistake, report it so it gets fixed for everyone, and request to allow it: this takes effect in 24 hours. Your streak is not affected.

fpPending.message: Request sent: this site will be accessible from $1. You can cancel it in the settings.

allowedHelp.message: Sites blocked by mistake that you allowed. An allowance takes effect 24 hours after the request; cancelling or removing it is immediate.

settingsStrictOnly.message: These settings can only be made stricter: longer wait, shorter access.

selfMessageLabel.message: A message from you to you

selfMessageHelp.message: Write it now, with a clear head. This is the text you will have to type out by hand to unlock (300 characters minimum). Leave empty to keep the default text.

err_baseWaitMin.message: The wait can only go up (24 h maximum).

err_accessMin.message: Access time can only go down (1 minute minimum).

err_selfMessage.message: The message must be at least 300 characters long.

journalHelp.message: Your answers from past unlocks. They never leave this device.

privacyNote.message: Rempart collects no data: no account, no analytics, nothing is sent over the internet.
